cues.en: As we've seen with Netflix, there's no need to choose a single algorithm for your recommender system.
cues.zh: 從 Netflix 可以看到，推薦系統不必只選一種演算法。

cues.en: Each algorithm has its own strengths and weaknesses, and you may end up with a better system by combining many algorithms together in what we call a hybrid approach.
cues.zh: 每種演算法都有優缺點，將多種演算法結合成所謂混合方式，可能得到更好的系統。

cues.en: We touched on it earlier, but these hybrid, or ensemble, approaches can make a real difference.
cues.zh: 先前稍微談過，但這些混合或集成方法，真的能帶來差異。

cues.en: The winner of the Netflix Prize came from a group called KorBell, and they won by creating an ensemble of 107 different algorithms that worked together!
cues.zh: Netflix Prize 的得獎者來自名為 KorBell 的團隊，他們建立了一個由 107 種不同演算法共同運作的集成系統，因此獲勝！

cues.en: The top 2 were SVD++ and RBM, both of which ended up in use by Netflix itself.
cues.zh: 其中最重要的兩個是 SVD++ 與 RBM，兩者最後都被 Netflix 採用。

cues.en: Another example of where an ensemble approach has been shown to work is with session-based recommendations.
cues.zh: 集成方法證實有效的另一個例子，是工作階段式推薦。

cues.en: Earlier, we covered using recurrent neural networks, or RNN's, to the problem of recommending items as part of a sequence of session data, this was called GRU4Rec.
cues.zh: 先前談過，把循環神經網路，也就是 RNN，應用於根據工作階段資料序列推薦項目的問題，這叫做 GRU4Rec。

cues.en: Its results were OK, but actually not as good as a simpler k-nearest-neighbor approach applied to the items in a user's session.
cues.zh: 結果還不錯，但其實不如把較簡單的 k 最近鄰方法，應用於使用者工作階段中的項目。

cues.en: However, by combining GRU4Rec with a KNN approach, the resulting system performed better than either approach did individually.
cues.zh: 不過，把 GRU4Rec 與 KNN 結合後，系統表現比兩者各自單獨使用更好。

cues.en: Hybrid approaches can also be useful in solving the cold start problem.
cues.zh: 混合方法也有助於解決冷啟動問題。

cues.en: If we can augment recommender systems based on real user behavior such as clicks, views, or ratings with semantic data about the items themselves, we can produce a recommender system that uses
cues.zh: 如果能用項目本身的語意資料，補充根據點擊、觀看、評分等真實使用者行為的推薦系統，就能建立一個，

cues.en: behavior data when it's available, but can fall back on content attributes when it needs to.
cues.zh: 有行為資料時使用它，必要時則退回使用內容屬性的推薦系統。

cues.en: For your final exercise in this course, I'll challenge you to build your own hybrid recommender.
cues.zh: 本課程最後一個練習，我要挑戰你建立自己的混合推薦器。

cues.en: As with most things, there's more than one way to do it, perhaps you could reserve some slots in your top-N results for certain recommenders.
cues.zh: 和大多數事情一樣，做法不只一種。也許可以保留 Top-N 結果中的一些位置，給特定推薦器。

cues.en: Perhaps you use one recommender primarily, with various fall-backs to use in case the primary recommender could not fill all of your top-N slots.
cues.zh: 也許以某個推薦器為主，若主要推薦器無法填滿所有 Top-N 位置，再採用各種備援方式。

cues.en: Or perhaps you generate rating predictions from many recommenders in parallel, and add or average their scores together before ranking them.
cues.zh: 或者，平行使用多個推薦器產生預測評分，先加總或平均分數，再排序。

cues.en: The latter approach is what I'm going to challenge you to do.
cues.zh: 我要挑戰你做的是最後這種方式。

cues.en: Write a new algorithm in the recommender framework we've created for this course, called HybridAlgorithm.
cues.zh: 在本課程建立的推薦框架中，寫一個叫做 HybridAlgorithm 的新演算法。

cues.en: All it should do is take in a list of other algorithms that are compatible with surpriselib and a weight you wish to assign to each, and train each of those algorithms when calling fit on your HybridAlgorithm.
cues.zh: 它只需要接收其他與 SurpriseLib 相容的演算法清單，以及每個演算法的權重；對 HybridAlgorithm 呼叫 fit 時，就訓練所有這些演算法。

cues.en: When estimate is called to generate a rating prediction for a specific user/item pair, compute a weighted average based on each algorithm in the list, and the weights associated with each.
cues.zh: 呼叫 estimate，為特定使用者與項目組合產生預測評分時，根據清單中每個演算法及其權重，計算加權平均。

cues.en: Then, try it out, and see how your HybridAlgorithm performs compared to using its component algorithms individually.
cues.zh: 接著試用看看，將 HybridAlgorithm 的表現，與各個組成演算法單獨使用時比較。

cues.en: Which recommenders you choose to combine is up to you; personally, I chose to combine our RBM algorithm with the Content-based KNN algorithm we developed earlier, in the spirit of combining behavior-based and
cues.zh: 要結合哪些推薦器由你決定。我個人選擇把 RBM 演算法，和先前開發的內容式 KNN 演算法結合，目的是將行為式與，

cues.en: semantic-based information together into a single system.
cues.zh: 語意式資訊，整合到同一個系統。

cues.en: It's easier than it sounds, so try and give it a shot yourself.
cues.zh: 做起來比聽起來容易，所以試著自己做。

cues.en: Up next, I'll review my solution and results to this problem.
cues.zh: 接著，我會介紹這個問題的解答與結果。
